title: Your Dynamic funnel
outro_say: That's the Dynamic funnel. | A Candidate matches your conditions. It is not a recommendation to trade.

steps.screen: A card: your funnel on the dashboard
steps.say: Once you have a funnel, it works for you every hour. | Here's where to see what it found.

steps.screen: Switching the table to Dynamic funnel
steps.say: Above the crypto table, switch My Watchlist to Dynamic funnel. | Each of your funnels is one row.
The chips count the assets holding each stage, then Flagged and Candidates. | Click a chip to show those assets.
The table lists them, largest first, with the stage each one has reached.
On the row: pause or resume the funnel, start it again, or open it to edit.
It also shows in Quick Snapshot, with what changed since you last looked.
Switch back to My Watchlist any time. Your choice is saved.
